description: Defines the GeneralLossAlgorithm class implementing loss detection logic for QUIC, including TCP loss detection approaches, reordering thresholds, and adaptive loss detection features.

classes.name: GeneralLossAlgorithm
classes.description: Implements loss detection logic for QUIC, including TCP-style loss detection, reordering thresholds, and adaptive detection features.

methods.name: DetectLosses
methods.description: Determines which packets are lost based on current unacked packets, time, RTT stats, and acknowledgments.

methods.name: GetLossTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout value for loss detection.

methods.name: SpuriousLossDetected
methods.description: Handles spurious loss detection scenarios, adjusting thresholds accordingly.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the loss detection algorithm with packet space and parent interface.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the loss detection algorithm.

methods.name: set_reordering_threshold
methods.description: Sets the reordering threshold for loss detection.

methods.name: set_use_adaptive_reordering_threshold
methods.description: Enables or disables adaptive reordering threshold.

methods.name: enable_adaptive_time_threshold
methods.description: Enables adaptive time threshold for loss detection.

methods.name: disable_packet_threshold_for_runt_packets
methods.description: Disables packet threshold for runt packets.
